Köder.et: From Middle High German quërder, from Old High German quërdar, from Proto-Germanic *kwerþraz (“bait”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʷérh₃-tro-s, from the root *gʷerh₃- (“to devour”).

Kodierungsrichtlinie.et: From Kodierung, the interfix s and the word Richtlinie.

s: code (system of unwritten but binding rules)
Kodex.et: Borrowed from Latin cōdex. Doublet of Code.

kodifizieren.et: From Kodex with suffix -fizieren, from Latin cōdex.
